Bulletin for the regional network. An M 4 event was listed on the board in the morning, and the staff discussed what the letter stood for in that table. In the same office, the M column of the budget sheet shows spending per month. A separate note mentions an M-class flare seen by a partner observatory. The network added two new stations this year and retired one old one. Data from all stations is archived each night and checked the next morning. The team meeting moved to Thursdays at ten. New volunteers are welcome to help with the open day in the summer, which usually draws several hundred visitors. The coffee machine in the break room was replaced after many years of service. Training for the new archive software will run over two afternoons next month. Reports from the field crew described muddy roads and one flat tire, but no damage to equipment.
